title: Carte scolaire nationale : la Guinée enclenche la révolution de la planification éducative
why_not: The carte scolaire nationale is a planning map for siting schools and allocating teachers and equipment, launched as a process on 29 April 2026 by the education ministry with the Plan ministry and INS; it holds no record per learner and the text states nothing on school records, financing or schools reached.
